name: touch sensitivity off
steps: Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to disable it.

name: touch sensitivity on
steps: Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity.

name: navigation bar (leaf over Display)
steps: Select Buttons to turn off full screen gestures.

name: swipe for split screen
steps: Tap the switches next to Swipe for split screen.

name: screen timeout
steps: From Settings, search for and select Screen timeout.
Adjust the settings so your phone stays on for longer.

name: back up data
steps: Select Back up data to secure your personal files.

name: power saving on
steps: Tap the switch next to Power saving.

name: eye comfort shield on
steps: Tap the switch next to Eye comfort shield.

name: mobile data on
steps: Tap the switch next to Mobile data.

name: physical restart (no screen)
steps: Press and hold the Power button.
